purpose: Resident-led, evidence-aware home design prompts. This contract does not certify a house, building plan, product, legal compliance, or life safety.
non_negotiable_rules: No item is verified by selecting one or more functional design dimensions.
Unknown, proposed, resident preference and professional review are distinct states.
Life-safety, egress, fire, structure, electrical work and regulated requirements need applicable qualified review.
A smartphone or cloud-connected service is not assumed to substitute for an approved life-safety system.
The resident is the authority on their own preferences and consent.
No universal dimensions are inserted without a pinned jurisdiction/standard/use-case basis.

checks.target: 100% of displayed prompts carry room/task, rationale, evidence question and reviewer role
overlapping selections preserve all applicable prompts and do not remove the universal baseline
zero unverified items presented as verified
zero paths where selecting design dimensions creates compliance or construction readiness
100% of missing site, dimension, device or jurisdiction evidence remains visibly unresolved
100% of selected mandatory resident priorities are retained or shown in an explicit unresolved conflict with a next action
all generated prompts are optional to include, edit or remove in the planning brief
prototype stores no diagnosis, identity, location, or personal profile outside transient UI state
unresolved life-safety/egress questions block any future ready-for-construction state
100% of relevant connected or automated proposals include manual fallback, power/network failure, privacy and maintenance review
alerts are reviewed by type, resident and applicable qualified professional; no phone-only life-safety assumption

proposed_gates.name: Digital accessibility
proposed_gates.target_standard: WCAG 2.2 AA for the planner UI

checks.target: manual keyboard and screen-reader passes for all critical planner tasks
review zoom/reflow, focus, contrast, touch targets and reduced motion
automated scan alone cannot pass this gate
paid co-design and observed task walkthroughs with disabled residents before usability claims
report critical task blockers separately by relevant cohort; aggregate pass cannot hide a blocked user group
site measurements, applicable regulations, structure, electrical, alarms and egress reviewed by qualified people before construction claims
later real-home studies retain unresolved barriers and adverse results; no claim of safety/accessibility without corresponding evidence

research_sources.title: ISO 21542:2021
research_sources.use: Built-environment accessibility and usability scope; confirm current standard status before project use

research_sources.title: South African National Strategic Framework on Universal Design and Access
research_sources.use: South African policy context; not a building-specific approval

research_sources.title: RNIB adapting your home
research_sources.use: Blind/low-vision adaptations and individual task needs

research_sources.title: RNID smoke alarm systems
research_sources.use: Deaf/hard-of-hearing sensory alert considerations; device fit and jurisdiction still need qualification

research_sources.title: Deafblind UK
research_sources.use: Individual variation in deafblind experience and supports

evidence_policy.rule: Evidence receipts are separate from this target contract. A successful schema parse, Rust test, rendered UI or profile selection does not qualify a home.
